title: Casein-based film enriched with lignin as a biodegradable substrate for enzyme immobilization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5344-5355
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08521C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Elena Dembech, Giovanna Sotgiu, Anna Donnadio, Sara Buoso, Giovanni Dolci, Mary Jo F. A. Nichilo, Valentina Sinisi
Biodegradable films were prepared starting from milk extracted casein, even in combination with lignin. The films were used to immobilize glucose oxidase from Aspergillus niger and tested to detect the presence of glucose in solution.
